cases.text: PX4's battery-resistance estimate was 0 for the whole second half of the flight (it was already 0 when the vehicle took off), but BAT1_R_INTERNAL is set (5.0 mOhm per cell), so PX4 used that value, not the estimate.

PX4's battery-resistance estimate was 0 for the whole second half of the flight (it first reached 0 6.4 s after takeoff) while BAT1_R_INTERNAL is -1 (use the estimate), so PX4 did not correct the voltage-based state of charge for the voltage drop under load: it reads low under load and recovers after landing. On public PX4 flights this happened on 9 of 53 that use the estimate. A wrong current sensor scale or offset can also cause it. To see why, log one flight from boot (SDLOG_MODE 2) and add the line `battery_status 0` to etc/logging/logger_topics.txt on the SD card (PX4 then logs that topic at full rate, on top of its default topics). See PX4's battery estimation guide: https://docs.px4.io/main/en/config/battery
PX4's battery-resistance estimate did not collapse: it ended the flight at 10.5 mOhm per cell (public PX4 flights: median 2.7, p10-p90 1.2-7.5).

takeoff.text: PX4's battery-resistance estimate was 0 for the whole second half of the flight (it was already 0 when the vehicle took off) while BAT1_R_INTERNAL is -1 (use the estimate), so PX4 did not correct the voltage-based state of charge for the voltage drop under load: it reads low under load and recovers after landing. On public PX4 flights this happened on 9 of 53 that use the estimate. A wrong current sensor scale or offset can also cause it. In flight the estimate barely updates, and on 90 of 211 public PX4 flights it had already settled at the first logged sample (studies/battery-r-2026/GRADE-replay.md), so a log that starts at arming may not show why. To see why, log one flight from boot (SDLOG_MODE 2) and add the line `battery_status 0` to etc/logging/logger_topics.txt on the SD card (PX4 then logs that topic at full rate, on top of its default topics). See PX4's battery estimation guide: https://docs.px4.io/main/en/config/battery
